text: Mobile app development involves creating software for smartphones and tablets. A key part of this process is responsive design, which ensures that an app works well on different screen sizes. Developers must also choose between native and cross-platform development. Native apps are built for one platform, while cross-platform apps can run on several. After development, apps are usually published on app stores, such as Google Play or the App Store, where users can download them. Finally, performance is very important. A good app should load quickly and run smoothly, or users may delete it and choose a competitor instead.
